description: Model-specific structured regression corpus for the Interpretation V0 semantic parser. Each frozen_candidate is the reviewed parse a correct parser returns (evidence cited by span text); expected fields are scored exactly, unstated fields are not scored. Design evidence only: never training labels, prompt text, or runtime branches. Where a message has more than one defensible parse, the reviewed alternatives are listed as {"any_of": [...]}; a parse outside them fails. v0.2 (Collaborative Content and Inquiry V0) adds the requested-outcome contrast pairs (content delivered in the conversation versus an effect outside it), indirect, polite, interrogative, hypothetical, quoted, negated, corrected, compound, and ambiguous forms, context after a greeting, and the reviewed dinner vertical slice with an answer bound to a supplied open inquiry; the original trace is re-reviewed under the same distinction.
